market_overview.notes: RISK-OFF. 创业板 -5.37%, 科创50 -4.03%, 深证 -3.42%. Breadth 1.125:1 (below 1.5:1 buy gate). Tech massacre: 通信设备 -9.19%, 元件 -8.11%, 半导体 -4.88%. Only consumer defensives green (休闲食品 +3.76%, 饮料乳品 +2.24%). Global semiconductor rout (费城半导体 -22% from June peak) + fund style-control rules driving capitulation. IV elevated across all ETFs (科创50 73%, 创业板 64%). All 5 positions opened yesterday underwater — cutting 4, holding 1. Cash at ~77% after sells. No new positions.
